readinessHtml:
INPATIENT ROTATION READINESS

For all inpatient rotations, it is highly recommended that you spend ½ day shadowing your predecessor before starting, as you are generally expected to hit the ground running on day one.

Shadowing is not an excused absence from your current rotation. Coordinate with your predecessor to shadow after hours or on a weekend to gain exposure to the service without interfering with your current rotation responsibilities.

Complete all required credentialing, EMR access, and facility access in advance of your start date.

Although PC/Chiefs are here to help and navigate, it is the incoming resident’s responsibility to ensure they are ready to begin the service. Confirm your readiness and any outstanding requirements with the program coordinator, chief residents, and service attending before the rotation begins, if needed.
